shell.assistantHint: The assistant panel is reserved. It does not call a model in this milestone.
shell.assistantBody: Navigation and actions are available from the command palette. An assistant that can answer from your role comes later.

login.title: Sign in
login.sub: Company accounts use Google, Microsoft, or SSO. Auditors and testers use email.
login.auditorNote: Auditor? Use the invite link from your client.
login.localBanner: Local identity mode — development only. This mode is disabled outside Development and Testing. Google, Microsoft, SSO, and MFA run through WorkOS once credentials are set.
login.passkeyNote: Passkey verification stays with WorkOS. This screen completes authenticator-app codes. Enable an authenticator factor if that is the only option you have.
login.resetSent: If this account can reset a password, WorkOS will email you.
login.resetUnavailable: Password reset is available when WorkOS is configured.

errors.local_identity_mode: Google, Microsoft, and SSO need WorkOS. This environment is using local identity mode.
errors.sso_not_configured: No SSO organization is configured for that email domain.
errors.mfa_enrollment_required: WorkOS requires MFA enrollment before this account can sign in.
errors.mfa_factor_unsupported: This account's MFA factor is not an authenticator code. Enroll an authenticator app in WorkOS.
errors.mfa_challenge_failed: The authenticator challenge could not be started.
errors.email_verification_required: Verify the email address with WorkOS before signing in.
errors.account_conflict: This email is already linked to a different identity.
errors.email_required: Enter a work email to continue with SSO.
errors.redirect_not_allowed: This sign-in return address is not allowed.
errors.invalid_state: The sign-in request could not be matched. Try again.
errors.unknown_provider: That sign-in provider is not available.

dashboard.history: A history chart starts when automated tests run. These counts are the current example workspace.
dashboard.integrationsEmpty: Nothing is connected. AWS, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, and GitHub arrive in the next milestone.
dashboard.exportLater: Report export arrives in a later milestone.

frameworks.title: Frameworks
frameworks.sub: Requirements are content. One control can map to more than one framework.

controls.title: Controls
controls.sub: One control can satisfy requirements across the frameworks in this workspace.
controls.evidenceLater: Evidence storage and integrity checks arrive in a later milestone. Nothing is stored for this control yet.

activity.title: Activity
activity.sub: Sign-in and access events for this workspace.
